guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Outlook
section: •Gross Bookings of approximately $5.74 billion to $5.94 billion, up approximately 13% to 17% year over year.
•Adjusted EBITDA of approximately $188 million to $213 million, up approximately 22% to 38% year over year.
◦Adjusted EBITDA margin (calculated as a percentage of Gross Bookings) of approximately 3.3% to 3.6%.
